description: Example measurement-to-FFW mapping for the 5-site FABRIC subset (topology/fabric-sites.json: LOSA 0-1, SALT 2-3, STAR 4-5, NEWY 6-7, MICH 8-9). The iperf3 entries match the committed loopback samples in trace/samples/iperf3/; the prometheus entries match the synthetic node-exporter series in trace/samples/prometheus/. On a real slice, match iperf3 runs by --title or local_host, and Prometheus series by instance+device of each node's dataplane NIC.

iperf3.notes: UDP 500 Mbps fixed rate, 6 s, 0.5 s reporting; matched by iperf3 --title
TCP (capped at 1 Gbps): achieved == offered caveat applies; terminal ids given numerically (SALT.0 -> STAR.0)

prometheus.notes: LOSA worker dataplane NIC; all its traffic is assumed to be headed for MICH
